effects.name: target-store-merge-boundary
effects.detail: when a replayed merge writes an incoming MergeRecorded, its ours_head is the digest on the receiving chain at which its replayed block begins (the replayed counterpart of the source boundary, or the staging head where that boundary was filtered); theirs_head keeps the source value; the record keeps its source claims; every other record is written as before, in the merge's one atomic commit, and a refused merge writes nothing

effects.name: legacy-merge-boundary
effects.source: the source (theirs) Vouch store's verified event chain
effects.capture: when a merge needs the block boundary of a stored MergeRecorded whose ours_head is not an earlier record of that chain, the refusal names that record's digest; nothing is written and no lock is taken
